title: Yesterday at the shop
description: Listen to a short story about yesterday and choose what you hear.
audioText: Yesterday I went to the shop. I bought milk and bread. The bread was cheaper than at the supermarket.

items.prompt: Where did the speaker go yesterday?
items.promptIt: Dove è andato il parlante ieri?

items.prompt: Complete: The bread was ____ than at the supermarket.
